name: codex-completion-piano
description: Play a gentle two-second piano phrase on Windows when remote Codex finishes or asks a question.

codexCompletionPiano.enabled.description: Play the piano phrase when Codex finishes or asks a structured question on the connected machine.

codexCompletionPiano.scope.description: Play for all working directories on the connected machine, or only the open workspace.

codexCompletionPiano.markerPaths.description: Map VS Code remote authorities to absolute completion marker paths. Unlisted machines use the path embedded by the installer.
